gate: M10/1 Active; scoped Video source diagnostics delivered; complete common-codec acceptance open
deliverable: The channel Inspector and existing preview messages expose Video readiness, duration, typed failure reason and automatic retry state. InspectVideoSource, a typed command and the actual inspectVideoSource QuickJS method use the same bounded backend read. Source failures remain separate from renderer/device health and do not interrupt healthy sources.

semantics.readiness: Unconfigured, Loading, Prepared, Ready, Unavailable and Recovering are Rust-owned generated states. Prepared is timing only with no active decoder. Ready is an available decoded stream, not an exact seek or display-present claim. A build without video-files reports unsupported playback without promising a retry.
semantics.failures: Missing, Unsupported, Decode, Capacity and Io are typed kinds with at most256 Unicode characters of detail. Golden exposes typed conversion failures and missing-codec rejection; the app does not parse human-readable error strings to classify support. Actual BT.2020-matrix and PQ-transfer fixtures reject through that typed boundary. Current frame-step metadata is revoked on decode failure.
semantics.ownership: Source-owner and authored-File generation fences reject retired failures. Metadata failures retain known duration during transient endpoint loss; successful re-probing clears them. The metadata and decoder IO owners retain their existing bounded retry policy. No new authored settings, document polling, file IO or decoder work enters the UI/engine.
semantics.ui: One selected-source query in flight, one one-second timer, background activity classification and edit-session deferral. Selection/File/project/connection changes dispose/fence old readers, late replies and timers. The compact status reuses the generic channel Inspector. Preview messages follow canonical References and explicit Cell-editor dependencies; disabled sources retain normal presentation. Renderer Footer health stays separate.

verification.strict: Combined MapGyver/golden_video --lib --tests Clippy with video-files/ffmpeg/qualification and -D warnings exits0. Default MapGyver --lib --tests strict Clippy exits0.
verification.generated: generate_media_protocol completes with exit0; full app generated-contract equality passes. New status DTOs, request/result, command kind/fields and all consumers ship together. Existing preview strings carry the presentation without another duplicated source schema.
verification.ui: npm run check --workspace mapgyver-ui exits0 with zero errors/warnings. All six source-reader and operation/activity tests pass: serialization of reads, skipped reads preserving health, transport retry, old-response/old-timer/disposal fencing and project/loading/disconnect invalidation. Authored UI/templates use the repository formatter; root and golden_core cargo fmt complete.
verification.real_files: Missing to corrupt to playable H.265 recovery alongside a healthy H.264 source, exact Reference preview messages, unchanged authored history and Running renderer state. Real BT.2020-matrix and PQ-transfer H.264 failures relink to SDR H.264 and become Ready. Worker/image retirement passes. Metadata-only endpoint loss/relink reports the current problem while retaining known timing. Current/retired File and decoder tokens, bounded Unicode details, Prepared versus decoded Ready and Recovering state have focused coverage.

fixture_correction: The initial new PQ fixture omitted its intended transfer/primaries in the H.264 stream. The app unsupported-source case timed out; its isolated backtrace identified the initial rejection wait, and the Golden conversion test also failed. FFprobe confirmed only bt709 color_space with no transfer. The test encoder now writes explicit H.264 VUI via its supported h264_metadata filter; FFprobe reports smpte2084/bt709 and both typed rejection tests pass. The runtime rejection rule, retry interval, deadlines and color conversion algorithm are unchanged. The initial comma-packed -Only invocation produced no fixtures; the corrected PowerShell array invocation generated and verified only the two new tiny files. Earlier failures are not counted as passing evidence.
native_limit: No desktop input or new hardware/native experiment. Preview message integration is verified on actual captured channel/Reference metadata with the Null renderer, and UI component/type/store behavior is checked. Actual-app visual playback, new hardware-decode/profile coverage and sustained performance remain unverified here; prior native pixel evidence retains its original scope.
